import React, { useState } from "react"; export default function OtherComplaintPage() { const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: "", rollNo: "", email: "", phoneNumber: "", subgroup: "", branch: "", hostelName: "", roomNumber: "", complaint: "", }); function onChange(e) { const { id, value } = e.target; setForm((p) => ({ ...p, [id]: value })); } function onSubmit(event) { event.preventDefault(); const name = form.name.trim() || null; const rollNo = form.rollNo.trim() || null; const email = form.email.trim() || null; const phoneNumber = form.phoneNumber.trim() || null; const subgroup = form.subgroup.trim() || null; const branch = form.branch.trim() || null; const hostelName = form.hostelName.trim() || null; const roomNumber = form.roomNumber.trim() || null; const complaint = form.complaint.trim() || null; const newComplaint = { ...(name && { name }), ...(rollNo && { rollNo }), ...(email && { email }), ...(phoneNumber && { phoneNumber }), ...(subgroup && { subgroup }), ...(branch && { branch }), ...(hostelName && { hostelName }), ...(roomNumber && { roomNumber }), ...(complaint && { complaint }), formType: "Other Complaint", }; const complaints = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("complaints")) || []; complaints.push(newComplaint); localStorage.setItem("complaints", JSON.stringify(complaints)); alert("Complaint submitted successfully!"); setForm({ name: "", rollNo: "", email: "", phoneNumber: "", subgroup: "", branch: "", hostelName: "", roomNumber: "", complaint: "", }); } return ( <>
